_comment: Curated machine rules for the deterministic decoder (Layer 2). Keyword keys are matched case-insensitively against the label's point-name tokens. NO point-specific facts here: those live in validated_decodes.jsonl / data_observations.md. Cited as deterministic_rules.json:<section>.<key>.

alarn._comment: observed typo for alarm in Tasen labels

varme.carrier_hint: varme (heating context; carrier itself needs el/fjernvarme evidence)

hovedtavle._comment: hovedtavle = main electrical distribution board (CLAUDE.md keyword list: lys/strom = electrical; observed in Skoyen WM02_Energi_Hovedtavle)

point_name_keywords._comment_rejected_keywords: 'strom'/'strøm' -> carrier el is deliberately ABSENT: as a substring it collides with 'overstrømning' (NS 36xx undernummer .07, CLAUDE.md section 3). Add a longer, specific form (e.g. strommaaler) if data ever shows one.
point_name_keywords._comment_swegon: Swegon WISE room-control grammar (Skoyen): per-room comfort setpoints and airflow parameters. H/C = heating/cooling sequence, Occ/Uocc = occupied/unoccupied, natt/morgen = night/morning setback.

system_carrier._comment: NS 3451 system prefix -> carrier, applied only when carrier is still null: the medium follows from the system for 37xx (kjoling, TFM systemkodeliste 370). Deliberate omissions: 32xx heating carrier is el OR fjernvarme and needs keyword evidence (the pilot's 310 lesson: semantics live in the text); 36xx air has no matching value in the schema carrier enum. Also rejected: IK -> cooling system (komponentkodeliste.md line 309: IK = Kuldeaggregat covers Kjolemaskin, Frysemaskin AND Varmepumpe -- a heat pump is not a cooling system).

side_digit_subsystem._comment: Only applied when the component code has THREE digits (grammar: confirmed for 2-letter code + 3 digits). Convention is a hint -- data can override (see data_observations.md, FCB RT401).
